answer: Bind each agent identity to one hardware enclave that holds a non-transferable onyx key, and allow only one new identity per device per season. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge: it may do only small, reversible tasks while its device history is published under a public lantern for anyone to inspect. If the same enclave spawns a second identity, or its behaviour matches another identity too closely, both lose standing and the key is revoked. A Sybil farm then needs real hardware for every fake, not just new accounts, so cloning stops scaling while honest agents keep one cheap identity.
